spec.title: MCP rejection reasons
spec.description: Cumulative RAM counters: normalize resets per stable instance before summing replicas. First scrape is a baseline; calls since the final scrape before restart may be lost. Missing scrapes stay gaps. Only series with activity in the selected time range are shown; zero intervals for those series are retained. No Top-X limit is applied.

spec.query:
import "strings"
data = from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^mcp_reasons_.*_total$/)
  |> increase()
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
activeFields = data
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_field"])
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_field")
data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: activeFields))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: strings.title(v: strings.replaceAll(v: strings.trimSuffix(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "mcp_reasons_"), suffix: "_total"), t: "_", u: " "))}))

spec.title: MCP p95 duration (histogram)
spec.description: Cumulative RAM counters: normalize resets per stable instance before summing replicas. First scrape is a baseline; calls since the final scrape before restart may be lost. Missing scrapes stay gaps. Approximate p95 from summed cumulative bucket deltas, never averaged per-instance percentiles. No observations produce no sample.

spec.query:
import "math"
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^mcp_duration_buckets_le_.*_total$/)
  |> increase()
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with le: if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_inf_total" then float(v: "+Inf") else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_0_01_total" then 0.01 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_0_025_total" then 0.025 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_0_05_total" then 0.05 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_0_1_total" then 0.1 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_0_25_total" then 0.25 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_0_5_total" then 0.5 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_1_total" then 1.0 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_2_5_total" then 2.5 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_5_total" then 5.0 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_10_total" then 10.0 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_30_total" then 30.0 else if r._field == "mcp_duration_buckets_le_60_total" then 60.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sort(columns: ["le"])
  |> histogramQuantile(quantile: 0.95, countColumn: "_value", upperBoundColumn: "le", onNonmonotonic: "error")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not math.isNaN(f: r._value))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.title: MCP applications (current)
spec.description: All current self-reported application names and retained 30-day usage, read freshly through the authenticated instance-health datasource. This table is current state, independent of the selected chart period. Names are metadata, not verified vendor identities. No Top-X cap or replica summation.

spec.title: MCP adoption totals
spec.description: Database-wide client summary from the latest instance-health sample in the selected period. Every value comes from that same sample. Missing summaries remain missing rather than reusing older values. Unconsented registrations are separate from active connections and retained tool usage.

spec.query:
source = from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
latest = source
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mcp_calls_started_total")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
source
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time == latest._time)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^mcpClients_summary_(registeredClients|authorizedClients|activeClients30d|calls30d|applicationNames)$/)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Registered: r.mcpClients_summary_registeredClients, Authorized: r.mcpClients_summary_authorizedClients, ActiveClients30d: r.mcpClients_summary_activeClients30d, Calls30d: r.mcpClients_summary_calls30d, Applications: r.mcpClients_summary_applicationNames}))

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_missingCredentials" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_disabledAccount" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_refreshFailed" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_missingScope" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_apiRejected" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_apiError" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_rateLimited" or r._field == "clips_fallbackReasons_emptyResponse")
  |> increase()
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.title: MCP HTTP responses per minute
spec.description: Transport-level responses, separate from executed tools. 4xx includes expected OAuth challenges; it does not necessarily mean a tool failed.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mcp_requests_status_2xx_total" or r._field == "mcp_requests_status_3xx_total" or r._field == "mcp_requests_status_4xx_total" or r._field == "mcp_requests_status_5xx_total")
  |> increase()
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 60.0 / (float(v: int(v: v.windowPeriod)) / 1000000000.0)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.title: Crawler jobs waiting to run
spec.description: Due jobs available to workers, excluding disabled creators, future schedules and actively leased jobs.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "crawler_dueRecent" or r._field == "crawler_dueBackfill")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Crawler jobs running
spec.description: Jobs with an unexpired worker lease, excluding disabled creators.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "crawler_runningRecent" or r._field == "crawler_runningBackfill")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Crawler wait time
spec.description: Age of the oldest available due job and pending manual-refresh request. These are observed wait times, not promised start times. Zero means no matching pending work.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "crawler_oldestDueAgeSeconds" or r._field == "crawler_oldestManualWaitSeconds")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Crawler retries and expired leases
spec.description: Retrying jobs and expired worker leases awaiting recovery. Gauges, not lifetime failure counters. Disabled creators are excluded.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "crawler_retrying" or r._field == "crawler_expiredLeases" or r._field == "crawler_manualPending")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Emails ready to send
spec.description: Outbox notices due now, separated into first attempts and retries. Future scheduled reminders are shown separately.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "notifications_duePending" or r._field == "notifications_dueRetry")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Email delivery state
spec.description: Unexpired delivery claims, expired claims, failed notices and intentionally discarded notices. No-longer-applicable notices are skips, not provider failures. Sent history is excluded from the aggregate scan.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "notifications_claimed" or r._field == "notifications_expiredClaims" or r._field == "notifications_failed" or r._field == "notifications_skipped")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Oldest overdue email
spec.description: Age of the oldest pending/retry notice whose scheduled delivery time has passed. Zero means no due unclaimed notices. Expired claims are shown separately.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "notifications_oldestDueAgeSeconds")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Scheduled emails
spec.description: Future pending notices and retries; these are not overdue delivery backlog.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "notifications_scheduledPending" or r._field == "notifications_scheduledRetry")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
